args.title: Arguments
args.description: Default values of template variables, referenced as ${args.<key>} anywhere in the config and overridable at launch (--parameters=args.<key>=...). Earlier keys can be referenced by later ones. Values are used as strings; numbers and booleans are accepted and converted.

context.title: Context
context.description: Execution context: only modules whose `tags` contain this value are assembled (switch e.g. train/predict paths in one config).

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: Merge modules defined in other config files into this pipeline (module names must be unique across files).

base.title: Base
base.description: Prefix for the file paths (e.g. gs://bucket/configs/)

files.title: Files
files.description: Config files to import, relative to base

args.title: Args
args.description: Template variables applied when loading the imported files (override system.args for those files)

failFast.title: Fail Fast
failFast.description: true: fail the job on the first error. false: keep running and route failed records to the dead-letter sinks.

union.title: Union Failures
union.description: Collect the failure records of all modules into a single dead-letter output.

sinks.title: Dead-Letter sinks
sinks.description: Dead-letter sink module definitions (same shape as a sink: name, module, parameters)

alterConfig.title: Alternative config
alterConfig.description: Config (path or text) to assemble instead when assembling this pipeline throws.
